_comment: The word line's grammar, as cases every parser must agree on: lib/wordline.py, lib/wordline.lua (the PDF) and lib/wordline.js (the pages). Errors and warnings are compared by CODE, never by sentence, so each parser may word its message in its own voice. parse and align are run by all three; render by Python and JavaScript; check and divide by Python, and check by JavaScript too, which runs it live under the word strip. Run by tests/smoke.py. aloud -- one chunk as the aloud pass reads it: its reading, then the text's closing punctuation the reading leaves out -- is run by all three in tests/test_wordbook_tex.py, because the PDF's pass and the reader's must end a chunk on the same marks.

parse.line: 山(やま) へ 柴刈り(しばかり) に 、

parse._why: the ideographic space an input method types separates words, and so does padding
inside parentheses whitespace is the reading's, collapsed to one space
fullwidth parentheses that open the word are text

parse.line: 柴刈り（しばかり） に

parse._why: okurigana outside the parentheses: read leniently it is a reading over the wrong characters
it would parse as the word 山( and could never be written back: token() refuses it, so parse() must

align._why: a space in the text is drawn from the text, though the line cannot spell it
compared code point by code point: が decomposed is not が, so no parser accepts what the PDF would refuse

check.line: 山(やま) へ 柴刈り(しばかり) に 、
check._why: the chunk kana leaves the 、 out and the words keep it: they agree all the same

check.line: 山(やま) へ 柴刈り(しばかり) に
山 へ 柴刈り(しばかり) に 、
楚人(そひと) 有(あり) 鬻(ひさぐ) 盾(たて) 與(と) 矛(ほこ) 者(もの)
check.reading: そひとにたてとほことをひさぐものあり
check._why: kanbun: the reading reorders the words, and the document says so

check.line: 楚人(そひと) 有(あり) 鬻(ひさぐ) 盾(たて) 與(と) 矛(ほこ) 者(もの)
check.reading: そひとにたてとほことをひさぐものあり

check.line: テレビ を 見る(みる)
我(wǒ) 想(xiǎng) 要(yào) 一(yì) 杯(bēi) 茶(chá)
check.reading: wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi chá

check.line: 我(wǒ) 想(xiǎng) 要(yào) 一(yī) 杯(bēi) 茶(chá)
check.reading: wǒ xiǎng yào yì bēi chá
check._why: tones are set aside: tr writes the changed tone of 一, the word keeps its own
a line decomposed where its text is not is refused here, not by the PDF build

divide.line: 山(やま) へ 柴刈り(しばかり) に 、
divide.second: 柴刈り(しばかり) に 、

divide.line: 山(やま) へ 柴刈り(しばかり) に 、
divide.first: 山(やま) へ 柴(しばかり)

divide.line: いい です ね
divide._why: a decomposed character counted once on both sides: the cut falls between words, not inside です

aloud._why: a text that closes on no punctuation adds none
the kana leaves the 、 out, and the pass puts it back
a reading that already ends with it is not given it twice
a reading that ends with part of the closing run is given the rest
no reading (a \chp, or a chunk nobody gave one): the text itself
whitespace, the ideographic space included, is no reading
whitespace inside the closing run is skipped, not kept; the reading's own is trimmed
U+2026, from the general punctuation block
an apostrophe inside the reading is the reading's, and the text closes on none
